summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests JNJ-87189401 combined with JNJ-78278343 in adults with advanced prostate cancer. The record does not state how the drugs are given or how often; doses are increased in steps across the study parts. The study measures the recommended regimen for later Phase 2 testing and the safety of the combination.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa JNJ-87189401 combinado con JNJ-78278343 en adultos con cáncer de próstata avanzado. El registro no indica cómo se administran los medicamentos ni con qué frecuencia; las dosis aumentan por pasos en las distintas partes del estudio. El estudio mide el régimen recomendado para una fase 2 posterior y la seguridad de la combinación.
who_for: Histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the prostate.
Measurable or evaluable disease per PCWG3 criteria.
Prior orchiectomy or ongoing GnRH analog therapy, for certain study parts.
not_for: Small cell, carcinoid, mixed, or large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma.
Autoimmune disease in the 12 months before consent.
Heart attack, severe or unstable angina, or serious ventricular arrhythmia within 6 months before consent.
Heart failure (NYHA class II to IV) within 6 months before consent.
Transient ischemic attack or stroke within 6 months before consent.
